name: toast
need: Confirm or report something briefly in a snackbar, with an optional action

--ds-toast-action-color.description: a text button in a snackbar (`.ds-toast__action`, Undo)

--ds-toast-close-size.description: the close button of a snackbar

--ds-toast-radius.description: a snackbar's radius at the default shape

labExempt.DS.toast.toast: the same function as DS.overlay.toast, shown in the snackbar entries
labExempt.DS.toast.closeToasts: the same function as DS.overlay.closeToasts, shown in the snackbar entries

physical..ds-toasts: left: script coordinate: --ds-toast-left, and DS.overlay reads the computed left back
